findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_collection_plans, upgrade_precon, reduce_deck_cost, repair_deck, change_deck_bracket, import_deck · Private data: plan_collection, list_collection_plans, save_collection_plan, import_deck · Public sink: build_mana_base, plan_collection, save_collection_plan · Destructive: plan_collection, save_collection_plan, delete_collection_plan, search_cards.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_collection_plans, upgrade_precon, reduce_deck_cost, repair_deck, change_deck_bracket, import_deck · Private data: plan_collection, list_collection_plans, save_collection_plan, import_deck · Public sink: build_mana_base, plan_collection, save_collection_plan · Destructive: plan_collection, save_collection_plan, delete_collection_plan, search_cards

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_cards" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search card names or Scryfall syntax. Supports exactName, maxManaValue, cardType, sort (edhrec or usd low-to-high), and up to 30 excludedNames. Exclusions filter the bounded result pool; narrow the query if too few remain. Optional WUBRG color identity and USD per-card price cap. C or blank colors m" → after: "Search card names or Scryfall syntax. Bare draw/card draw, counterspells, and mana rocks are interpreted as role searches; exactName and explicit Scryfall syntax are unchanged. If results miss the requested mechanic, refine the query rather than substitute unverified cards or prices. Optional comman"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
